sentences.en: My watchdog is alert to the slightest sound and movement.
sentences.zh: 我的看门狗一有声响或动静就会警觉起来。

sentences.en: A dog that barks all the time isn't a good watchdog.
sentences.zh: 一只总是叫唤的狗不是一个好的看门狗。

sentences.en: Maybe we need to get a watchdog.
sentences.zh: 也许我们需要请个监督者来帮忙。

senses.zh: 看门狗；监察人；忠实的看守人
